Interface IBindable<T>

Namespace: osu.Framework.Bindables
Assembly: osu.Framework.dll

An interface which can be bound to other osu.Framework.Bindables.IBindable`1s in order to watch for (and react to) Disabled and Value changes.

public interface IBindable<T> : ICanBeDisabled, IHasDefaultValue, IUnbindable, IHasDescription, IFormattable
